ns2:course.label: Acting Studio IV: Voice
ns2:course.description: Advanced training in voice and speech for the stage with emphasis on dialects. Enrollment limited to Theatre majors. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: THEA 471, THEA 472, THEA 473 and THEA 474, and concurrent enrollment in THEA 475, THEA 477 and THEA 478.
